evals.prompt: My druxt.js branch feature/412-empty-menu fixes issue #412 (DruxtMenu renders an empty <ul> with no items). Write the pull request title and description for me, but don't open it yet.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a Conventional Commits title scoped to menu and a description following the PR template with Types of changes, Description including Resolves: #412, Checklist and Screenshots/Media. Does not push or open the PR.
expectations: The title is a Conventional Commits subject such as fix(menu): ...
The description follows the sections of .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
The description links the issue with Resolves: #412
Does not push or open the pull request
